# Chaser

Chaser is an accounts receivable automation software that helps businesses automate invoice reminders and get paid faster.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/chaser/.

## Actions

- **Create Credit Note**: Create a new credit note record in the organization.
- **Create Customer**: Create a new customer record in chaser.
- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice record in the organization.
- **Get Credit Notes** (read-only): Retrieve a list of credit notes.
- **Get Customer by ID** (read-only): Retrieve details for a specific customer by their external (source system) id.
- **Get Customers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all customers associated with the organization.
- **Get Organization** (read-only): Retrieve information about the connected organizations.
- **Update Customer**: Update an existing customer's information using their unique externalid.
- **Update Invoice**: Update an existing invoice's information using its unique identifier.
